title.narrative: The UN Multi-Partner Human Security Trust Fund for the Aral Sea Region in Uzbekistan

description.narrative: The desiccation of the Aral Sea in Uzbekistan has devastating impacts on the environment and the population far beyond its national borders. For example, increasing amounts of salt in the water and soil lead to fish mortality, the contamination of drinking water, chronic diseases and failed harvests. The fund was established to strengthen the resilience of the affected population through effective governance and coordination of development cooperation in the Aral Sea region. The fund supported projects to improve income opportunities for the local population, access to affordable, healthy food and clean drinking water as well as the health of the population, particularly for vulnerable groups such as women, children and young people. For example, the funds were utilized to test new technologies in the areas of water treatment, agroforestry, reforestation and soil stabilization, develop reforestation methods and establish rural cooperatives for drying fruit and vegetables.
